app.title: MO Agri — Baseline + Fields
app.summary: A person picks a year range and sees average corn yield per county on a map, then picks a crop to see the statewide yearly mean with a band of one standard deviation across counties. They pick a county to see its vegetation-index time series and its yield history for a chosen crop. On a second tab they pick a monitored field and see its latest satellite tiles, its vegetation and radar time series with percentile bands, and a metrics card. The card scores the latest reading against the same time of year in earlier years and warns when the field falls well below that baseline. A third tab shows the same banded series for each county's cropland over a recent window.

task.text: Watch crop condition for counties and individual fields against their own history and the historical yield record, and flag fields whose latest reading falls well below the seasonal baseline.

data.text: County crop yields by year and commodity, county centroids, and per-county and per-field satellite time series (vegetation index and radar backscatter) with percentile summaries and the latest raster tiles.
data.item: a place (a county or a monitored field) with its yearly yields and its time series of satellite readings

stage.text: exploring in-season satellite readings for counties and fields against the historical yield and vegetation record

mechanism.text: Tabs split the work into a statewide historical view, a per-field view and a per-county live view. In each one, dropdowns and a year-range slider drive callbacks that redraw the map, the line charts with percentile bands, the tile previews and the metrics card for the chosen place.

field.text: satellite crop-condition monitoring and county yield records in agronomy

workflow.name: check each place's latest readings against its own history and flag the ones that fall below

steps.step: look over every item at a glance
steps.here: A year-range slider sets the period, and a map draws one bubble per county, sized and coloured by mean corn yield over that period.

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: A commodity dropdown shows the statewide mean yield per year with a ±1σ band across counties, and marks known drought years with dotted lines.
A county dropdown shows that county's vegetation-index series coloured by month, next to its yield history for a chosen crop.
A field dropdown shows the field's coordinates and buffer, its latest vegetation-index and radar tiles, and both time series as a mean line with a p10–p90 band.

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: The metrics card estimates the area of interest and the vegetated hectares, and gives z-scores for the latest vegetation and radar readings against the same day of year ±7 days in earlier years. It warns when either z-score is below −2.
A county dropdown on the live tab shows cropland-masked vegetation and radar series with p10–p90 bands, and gives the date of the latest scene.

distinctive: Each field is scored against its own same-day-of-year baseline from earlier years, and no score is given until three prior years exist.
Optical vegetation index and radar backscatter are shown together, with radar as a proxy for dryness.
Area estimates are computed from the field's buffer square and the share of pixels above a vegetation-index threshold.
County series are masked to row-crop land cover before they are summarised.
Known drought years are marked on the multi-year yield trend as reference lines.

parts.title: Statewide historical tab
parts.summary: Holds the county yield map, the crop trend, the county drill-down and a static correlation figure. A line at the top gives dataset counts.

parts.title: Crop yield trend
parts.summary: Shows the chosen crop's statewide mean yield per year, with a ±1σ band across counties and marked drought years.

parts.title: County NDVI + yield drill-down
parts.summary: For one chosen county, shows the vegetation-index series coloured by month next to the yield history of a chosen crop.

parts.title: Fields tab
parts.summary: For a chosen monitored field, shows its location, its latest vegetation-index and radar tiles, and both time series with p10–p90 bands. If no fields are configured, it says how to set them up.
